data.config.toml:
[info]
url = "http://mint:3338"
listen_host = "0.0.0.0"
listen_port = 3338
mnemonic = "abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon about"
enable_info_page = false
input_fee_ppk = 100
use_keyset_v2 = true

[info.quote_ttl]
mint_ttl = 600
melt_ttl = 120

[info.http_cache]
backend = "memory"
ttl = 60
tti = 60

[mint_info]
name = "Proofstorm CDK mint"
description = "Proofstorm regtest CDK mint"
urls = ["http://mint:3338"]

[limits]
max_inputs = 1000
max_outputs = 1000

[ln]
ln_backend = "lnd"
unit = "sat"
min_mint = 1
max_mint = 500000
min_melt = 1
max_melt = 500000

[lnd]
address = "https://lnd:10009"
cert_file = "/lnd/tls.cert"
macaroon_file = "/lnd/data/chain/bitcoin/regtest/admin.macaroon"

[database]
engine = "sqlite"
